title: Adaptive execution waves: run tools in evidence-driven batches, re-evaluate after each wave, update plan based on new signals — not one big serial queue
goal: Even with adaptive tool selection, running all RUN-column tools in one parallel batch misses chaining opportunities. A better model is adaptive execution waves: after each wave completes, the SignalProfile is updated with new findings and the planner re-evaluates WAIT runners to see if they now have evidence to move to RUN. Implement: (1) Wave 0 (low-impact recon): nmap + httpx → produces SignalProfile v1. (2) Planner scores all runners → RUN Wave 1 / WAIT / SKIP. (3) Wave 1 execution: run RUN tools in parallel (e.g. xss-extended, vuln-components, headers-security). (4) After Wave 1 completes: update SignalProfile v2 with new findings. Planner re-scores WAIT runners. Example: sqlmap was WAIT in Wave 1 (no injectable_parameter signal). After Wave 1, xss-extended found a form with a text field that echoed back input — this is a new signal. Planner re-scores: sqlmap moves to RUN Wave 2. (5) Wave 2: run new RUN tools. (6) After each wave, AI (via backlog-219 compound chain reasoning) checks for compound chains: 'Wave 1 found file-upload + stored-XSS. This combination enables CSRF cookie theft. Propose Wave 2: auth-flow + xss-extended on admin endpoint.' (7) Continue until no more WAIT runners can be unblocked or operator stops. Mission Control shows wave progress: 'Wave 1 complete: 5 runners done. Wave 2: 3 runners promoted from WAIT. 4 runners still SKIP.' The UI target from ChatGPT review: '7 selected, 11 skipped with reason, 5 waiting for evidence/approval' is the per-wave view. PREREQUISITE: backlog-256 (SignalProfile), backlog-258 (RunnerMetadata), backlog-255 (Planner).
scope: ChatGPT review 2026-05-06: 'Adaptive Execution Waves — not everything in one series, but batches: run relevant checks, process evidence, plan next wave.' This is the key architectural difference between AegisPT and simple scanners: continuous evidence-driven replanning.
generation_reason: ChatGPT identified adaptive waves as the final piece — one batch then stop is still suboptimal. Evidence from Wave 1 must feed Wave 2 planning so WAIT runners can be promoted.

inputs.prerequisite_backlog: backlog-256, backlog-258, backlog-255 must be completed first.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Waves are re-planning passes, not autonomous execution. Each wave requires operator approval before launching. WAIT promotions show as new proposals, not auto-dispatched.
constraints.safety: No wave auto-launches without operator approval. Intrusive runners always require explicit gate regardless of wave position. Maximum 5 waves per engagement to prevent runaway assessments.

success_criteria: After each wave completes, SignalProfile updated with new evidence from wave findings.
Planner re-scores WAIT runners against updated SignalProfile.
Runners promoted from WAIT to RUN appear as new proposals for operator approval.
Mission Control shows: 'Wave N complete. N runners promoted from WAIT. N still SKIP.'
sqlmap promoted from WAIT to RUN when Wave 1 finds form field with reflected input.
AI compound chain reasoning triggers wave proposals: 'file-upload + stored-XSS → CSRF cookie theft possible, propose auth-flow in next wave'.
Each wave requires operator approval before launching.
SKIP decisions persist across waves unless new contradicting signals found.
No regression in chain or planner tests.

acceptance_criteria: Wave 1 completion triggers SignalProfile v2 update.
WAIT runners re-scored after each wave.
Promoted runners appear as new proposals.
